policy: A namespace move is only safe when every consumer is provably updated - including consumers that were in the SAME namespace and therefore had no import statement to rewrite.

break_caught_and_fixed.symptom: BindingResolutionException: Target class [App\Services\CoverageService] does not exist.
break_caught_and_fixed.cause: AssetService type-hinted 'protected CoverageService $coverageService' and 'protected AssetDiscoveryFilterService $discoveryFilterService' from its own namespace, so no import statement existed to rewrite. The move silently broke its constructor.
break_caught_and_fixed.fix: Added the two missing use statements to app/Services/AssetService.php.
break_caught_and_fixed.detection: Found only by resolving the CONSUMER through the container. Resolving each migrated class in isolation had already passed, and grep for old FQCNs returned zero - both gave false assurance.

lesson: Verify namespace migrations by resolving every consumer through the container. Same-namespace consumers are invisible to a grep for import statements.
verification: grep old FQCNs across app/ routes/ config/ tests/ database/ bootstrap/ resources/ -> 0 hits
container resolution of each migrated class -> OK
container resolution of every consumer -> OK
full suite -> 571 passed, identical to baseline

not_migrated.reason: 18 are financial/booking/payment/settlement/availability hard stops; the rest are Eloquent-shaped or high-fan-in. Sequenced plan in phase-0.18-application-module-map.json.

The events are domain-specific (Booking, Payment, Notification, Campaign). Rule 26 requires preserving domain ownership for domain-specific events; only the genuinely cross-cutting subscriber was moved.
AssetObserver observes the Screen model and belongs to the Asset/Screen domain, not cross-cutting Support.
MediaHelper is a static utility consumed by controllers AND Blade views; relocating a view-referenced static helper is low value and non-zero risk.

psr4: App\ is PSR-4 autoloaded from app/, so no composer.json change was required.
